description:
This exceptional two-bedroom apartment has been extensively refurbished to an outstanding standard and is presented to the market in immaculate condition. Finished with high-quality materials throughout, the property offers bright, spacious accommodation with breathtaking views over Lough Mahon from both bedrooms, the living area and the private balcony.

Located within the exclusive gated Harty's Quay development, residents enjoy direct access to the Passage Railway Greenway along with beautifully maintained communal gardens and a peaceful waterfront setting. The development benefits from an on-site caretaker, ensuring the common areas are maintained to an exceptional standard all year round.

The apartment is serviced by lift access and includes one designated parking space, while refuse collection is included in the rent.

Accommodation comprises:

- Welcoming entrance hall with quality oak flooring
- Spacious family bathroom with bath and overhead shower
- Generous double bedroom with fitted wardrobe
- Master bedroom with en-suite bathroom and fitted wardrobe
- Bright open-plan kitchen, dining and living area with waterfront views
- Private balcony overlooking Lough Mahon
- Gas-fired central heating
- One designated parking space
- Refuse collection included
- Lift access
- Exclusive gated development with beautifully landscaped communal gardens

Offering a unique combination of luxury, tranquillity and convenience, this superb waterfront apartment is ideally suited to those seeking premium accommodation in one of Cork's most desirable residential developments.
